name: Cybernetic System Dynamics Model of Weight Management

mentions.name: Cybernetic System Dynamics Model of Weight Management
mentions.description: This research proposal applies cybernetics and system dynamics to human weight management, modeling how the body's mechanisms of food intake regulation and calorie expenditure form a coherent whole rather than studying them individually.
mentions.problem: A lot is known about individual mechanisms of how the body regulates food intake and calorie expenditure, but there have been no attempts to look at how these mechanisms form a coherent whole.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on a research proposal to basically take cybernetics and system dynamics to the problem of human weight management.

evidence.value: I’m working on a research proposal to basically take cybernetics and system dynamics to the problem of human weight management.
